title: An independently written execution kernel (client only, not an execution/1 provider) negotiates Context with the Context provider and Evidence with each Evidence provider, and enforces its own dispatch boundary from read-time claim facts over the public protocol: a valid required context dispatches, an advisory-only change does not stop required work, an invalidated required claim withholds the required dispatch while advisory work proceeds with its gap, mismatched bytes are never held, and unavailable knowledge is never valid; a kernel that ignores the boundary fails
